name: clearway
description: Waits for a free slot of RAM and CPU before heavy tasks, so parallel AI sessions do not freeze the machine.

interface.shortDescription: Queue heavy tasks across AI sessions
interface.longDescription: Before a build, a full test suite, a render or a local AI job, the session asks Clearway for a slot and waits for its turn, so several sessions do not exhaust RAM, CPU or VRAM at the same time.
